_meta.purpose: Authoritative record of bowl positions for Eval 1 data collection.

axes.x: +x is to the operator's RIGHT of the robot base origin (the base of the follower arm).
axes.y: +y is FORWARD on the table, away from the robot base (sometimes called 'up' when viewed top-down).
axes.z: +z is vertical (not tracked here — bowl always rests on the table plane).

_meta.convention_note: When the operator says 'up' from a top-down view of the workspace, that maps to +y in the robot base frame. Confirm with a ruler reading once before relying on these numbers for training.

role_legend.train: Position used during demo recording. Policy sees these in its training distribution.
role_legend.eval: Position used at evaluation rollout time. Should NOT overlap with any 'train' position so we measure true generalization, not memorization.
